clauses.title: Scope –  Requirements regarding materials, type,
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements regarding materials, type, shape, fabrication, assembly and finish of the top hung steel sliding shutters.

clauses.title: Size – The size
clauses.text: 2. Size - The size of the shutter shall be greater than the actual opening for weather protection. The height of the shutter shall be at least 150 mm more and width at least by 300 mm more that the size of the opening.

clauses.title: Angles, Tees, Flats, Channels etc, shall be of
clauses.text: 3.1 Angles, Tees, Flats, Channels etc, shall be of  rolled sections conforming to the prescribed   standards.

clauses.title: Top Runner (Track) –
clauses.text: 3.2 Top Runner (Track) - These shall be of cold rolled mild steel conforming to the prescribed standard, capable of taking the design load for a smooth operation.

clauses.title: Angles of size not
clauses.text: 4.1 Angles of size not less than 50×50×5mm for shutter upto 2 m width and 2.5m height and 65×65×6mm for bigger sizes shall be used.

clauses.title: Top track shall be
clauses.text: 4.2 Top track shall be either of the following types- Type A - Track made out of 12×80 mm flat securely anchored to the wall, Type B -  Cold rolled inverted U type mild steel track.

clauses.title: Bottom runner shall be
clauses.text: 4.3 Bottom runner shall be channel of about 50 × 40 × 5mm .

clauses.title: Sliding gear or roller
clauses.text: 4.4 Sliding gear or roller mechanism shall be as given in 5.4 of the standard.

clauses.title: Finish – The shutters
clauses.text: 5. Finish - The shutters shall be finished with a coat of red oxide primer. For detailed information, refer to IS 10451 : 1983  Specification for steel sliding shutters (top hung type).
